policy: Readiness is evidence-based. A division cannot be marked standby or operational solely because a plan or repository exists.

checks.name: Responsible owner and escalation route defined
Relevant automated and manual tests passed
Failure, recovery, and rollback procedures tested
Secrets, permissions, and data-handling review completed
Owner approval gates and prohibited actions enforced
Monitoring, reporting, and audit evidence available

evidence: Read-only listing CSV audit MVP exists.

Added an offline no-dependency per-order contribution calculator with explicit marketplace/payment fee, product cost, fulfilment shipping, packaging and other-variable-cost inputs, plus a sample CSV and six regression tests.

Calculator separates contribution before advertising, tax and overhead from revenue, and documents that the break-even ad-spend figure is a mathematical ceiling rather than a recommended budget; no marketplace or seller account is connected.
open_gaps: Ecommerce is an active rebuild workstream; existing storefront/listing baseline and product economics require a current read-only audit.
No verified sales, unit economics, fulfilment quality or customer-acquisition economics are established.
No listings, purchases, publishing, paid promotion or account changes are authorized.

Illustrative sample economics are not actual MidnightOtaku/Printify/eBay costs or fee schedules; current supplier, destination-specific shipping, marketplace fee, tax, returns and payout inputs must be independently verified before product decisions.
The offline calculator and tests have been added but not executed; no actual product-level profitability or demand validation is established.

evidence: Long-term studio ambition recorded in strategic planning.

Read-only Lovable project inspection on 2026-11-16 confirms the published project is in ready state and was last edited 2026-11-08; the homepage now has a clear welcome statement and direct quiz/character calls to action.

Current source confirms AniList primary with Jikan backup, all four original characters and local artwork, and three populated MidnightOtaku product cards with image assets, listing price snapshots and eBay destinations; the prior placeholder-card gap is resolved in source.

Lovable analytics for 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-16 report 19 visitors, 28 pageviews, 17 mobile and 2 desktop visitors; /characters is the most viewed route at 11 pageviews. Sample size is too small for reliable conversion or retention conclusions.
A detailed read-only product, technical and analytics audit is recorded in animora/READINESS-AUDIT-2026-11-16.md; no Lovable credits or project edits were used.
open_gaps: Original characters and brand assets must be preserved; Lovable credits and paid tools remain off limits until explicitly authorized.
No public changes, publishing, paid production or launch is authorized.
The services page still has no configured contact destination (CONTACT_EMAIL is null), so enquiries cannot yet be submitted through the site.
Character chats remain fixed demo replies with no persistence or real AI service; any real AI implementation requires separate privacy, moderation, cost and usage-limit design and owner approval.

Profile notification, autoplay and mature-title controls are localStorage preferences only and do not currently implement the labelled product behaviour; no account-backed cross-device profile/chat system is present.
Privacy/data-use page, current share image, real Android physical-device verification, accessibility review and fresh build/test run remain outstanding.
Analytics sample is small (19 reported visitors, 28 pageviews in the inspected 16-day window); no verified sales, customer enquiries, retention or product-market fit is established.

No broker-specific feed has completed API-license, account eligibility, instrument contract, data-rights and independent Risk/Technology review; current sources remain research-only.

evidence: The Control Centre records CAD 0 as the default operating budget and reserves financial transactions, borrowing and paid commitments for explicit owner approval.

Finance control validator now requires a proof reference and CAD basis before a received/settled/paid ledger row contributes to reported CAD cash receipts; non-CAD receipts are excluded pending documented conversion.
Finance regression suite expanded to 14 cases covering missing payout evidence, non-CAD receipt handling and malformed division registry input; tests are included but not executed.
Finance/MONTH-END-CLOSE.md documents the evidence-based period close, revenue reconciliation, commitment review, treasury reporting and exception escalation.
open_gaps: No live revenue or commitment entries have been reconciled; the current registers are empty and do not establish activity or balances outside the records.
No bank/payment account connection, independently verified cash balance, bank reconciliation, tax export or reserve execution workflow exists.
No named finance owner or active approval ledger is established; all positive spending remains blocked by the CAD 0 ceiling.
Halal screening is informational only; uncertain financing, investment, yield or trading structures require qualified review and no automated religious ruling is made.
Finance control tests and dashboard integration remain unexecuted; no bank/payment connector or independently verified balances exist.
